classification_reason: no known-limit hypothesis satisfies every fixed criterion

record.trace_source: extended-v1 snapshots captured by this harness

thm_limit_throttle.criterion: run plateau maximum ASIC temperature is strictly below THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE

details.criteria_note: THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE is reported as an optional snapshot-limit comparison and does not replace therm_trip_l1/shutdown criteria

details.criterion: power_w plateau time-weighted mean is at least TDP_LIMIT_MAX * (1 - 0.05) and within 5 percent of TDP_LIMIT_MAX; its onset is no later than AICLK drop onset
details.reference: Issue #118 plateau 132-135 W versus TDP 150 W (prediction/reference only)
details.board_power_criterion: report board_power_w plateau proximity to BOARD_POWER_LIMIT using the same 5 percent limit-near form; this is not the H-TDP signal criterion

evidence.finding: The API documents TDC in amps.
Blackhole telemetry uses the raw low 16 bits of TDC for current without a unit conversion.
TDC_LIMIT_MAX is used directly as tdc_limit, while the telemetry table labels the paired current as A.
The API documents ASIC temperature in Celsius.
The paired Core Temp telemetry is labeled in degrees Celsius.
THM_LIMIT_THROTTLE is copied directly to therm_trip_l1_limit; no conversion is applied.
Core Temp is labeled in degrees Celsius and is shown with the thermal throttle/temperature limit.
The underlying ASIC temperature API is Celsius.

limitations: The extended trace samples at a 2 second cadence; onset ordering has approximately 2 second temporal resolution.
Onset timestamps are starts of left-held sample segments, not interpolated events.
